summary: Frontend-only test of iteration 48 HotForex FX filters (route /hotforex) at 1920x1080. All 10 requested flows pass with no console errors: login, FX dashboard load, Filtros tab (USD regime/exposure/rollover/FOMC/vol/seasonality/12 pair rows/fix status), immediate-save toggle with toast, all new SettingsPanel switches/inputs/chips/LP strategy chip, save+reload persistence (restored to 2/50), fix_reversion backtest on EURUSD (1h forced, 10 trades, MFE/MAE/partials metrics), Rendimiento ExcursionStats (empty state), Plan de trading lists fix strategy, Docs mention 'Seis estrategias' + 'Filtros FX', /bybit has no Filtros tab.
action_items: Optional: the fix_reversion EURUSD backtest gives avg MAE = 2.49 R. The SL sits beyond the 15:00->16:00 extreme, so average MAE should be about 1 R or less. Check how the backtest/excursion code computes MAE in R for fix_reversion (R denominator, or MAE tracked from before entry / on the 15:00 reference bar).

Optional: the backtest trade list shows fix_reversion entries at 14:00 browser time (UTC). That is 15:00 London (BST), the start of the reference move, not the 16:00-16:20 entry window. Check whether entry_time is the reference candle's open time instead of the real entry time.

Note: SettingsPanel ('Estrategia y riesgo') with the new FX fields is in the main dashboard, not under the header 'Ajustes' view (which shows FxAdminSettings). The review request description was inaccurate; this works as coded.
critical_code_review_comments: FxFiltersPanel useEffect reloads /market/context only when certain settings change; it does not depend on seasonality_block_pairs/vol_min_pct, but those values are read from settings directly so this is fine. No polling, so vol percentiles stay static until a remount or a setting change (acceptable).
FxFiltersPanel: when data is null (fetch error) the spinner stays forever after the error toast. Consider an error/retry state.
Toggle buttons in FxFiltersPanel have no busy/disabled state, so a double-click can send two PUTs that cancel each other.
seed_data_creation: None. fx fomc_rule toggled off then on (restored). currency_exposure_limit 2->3->2, partial_tp_pct 50->40->50 (restored, verified after reload). Bot not started, PAPER mode kept.
